meta.name: issue
meta.description: Issue management for devloop — templates for goal, rule.yml, key-results, and issue lifecycle.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用模板管理开发任务的生命周期
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 devloop 中规范 issue 的创建和流转
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to standardize issue creation and tracking in devloop

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你创建和管理 GitHub Issue，自动填充目标、关键结果和规则模板，并跟踪问题从创建到关闭的完整生命周期。
howto.when: 当你需要为 devloop 项目创建新 Issue，或更新、验证、关闭已有 Issue 时触发。

say.text: 创建一个新的开发 Issue，目标为优化登录页加载速度。
say.note: Claude 会生成带模板的 Issue 命令。

say.text: 更新当前 Issue，添加进度记录和截图。
验证 Issue 并关闭，附上规则检查结果。
say.note: Claude 会执行验证并关闭。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and manage GitHub Issues, auto-filling goal, key results, and rule templates, and track the full lifecycle from creation to closure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a new Issue for a devloop project, or update, verify, or close an existing Issue.

say_en.text: Create a new dev issue with goal to optimize login page load time.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the Issue command with template.

say_en.text: Update the current issue with progress notes and screenshots.
Verify and close the issue with rule check results.
say_en.note: Claude will run verification and close.
